purpose: Independently test whether the frozen contract-green S6-I1-I4 implementation is mathematically and metrologically sufficient for a future full optimizer and paper-supporting experiment. This audit does not modify the frozen package, execute an optimizer/evaluator or create formal FFE.

input: frozen mathematical method and S6-I2/I3/I4 contracts
pure-function diagnostic inputs constructed without an objective or constraint callback
output: versioned amendment requirements and execution hold
analysis_contract.process: bind hashes -> compare live code/tests with frozen manifest -> collect tests without executing them -> inspect formulas and control flow -> run evaluator-free pure-function diagnostics -> classify consequences -> define amendment/red-test gate
analysis_contract.flow_logic: frozen evidence -> byte identity -> spec/code comparison -> uncovered boundary probe -> severity -> hold or release

identity_checks.interpretation: The findings apply to the accepted frozen S6-I1-I4 package; they are not caused by later source or test drift.

findings.title: Activation stability uses only thresholded edges instead of the frozen full weight matrices
findings.frozen_requirement: Method specification section 5 defines weighted Jaccard by summing min/max over every j<k entry of consecutive W matrices, with absent edges represented by zero.
implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/cvgr_graph.py:263-267 passes those thresholded maps to weighted_jaccard

deterministic_reproduction.construction: Both graphs share a 0.30 retained edge; a subthreshold pair changes from 0.19 to 0.01.

findings.consequence: Activation can be granted or denied under a different statistic than the frozen method, invalidating H1 activation and mechanism interpretation.
findings.test_gap: The existing Jaccard test calls weighted_jaccard directly on supplied edge lists and never verifies build_covio_graph against a full-matrix oracle.
findings.required_resolution: Specify and implement full-upper-triangle W Jaccard, including subthreshold positive weights, and add a gold boundary test.

findings.title: NMI is computed on the observed/truth node intersection and can reward missing constraints
findings.frozen_requirement: The synthetic representation endpoint compares recovered constraint blocks against the fixed truth partition and uses NMI>0.30 as a kill criterion.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/cvgr_graph.py:54 restricts NMI to set(observed) intersect set(truth).
findings.consequence: A method recovering only half the truth-node universe can receive perfect NMI, creating a false pass of the preregistered representation endpoint.
findings.test_gap: The sole NMI assertion compares an exact full recovery to itself.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze the truth-node universe and a missing-node policy; recommended policy assigns every missing observed node to a deterministic singleton/error label before NMI.

findings.title: Relief-pool quantile uses total population size rather than eligible population size
findings.frozen_requirement: Method specification section 7 defines the relief pool as the lowest 30 percent of eligible population members.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/cvgr_donor.py:60-63 computes ceil(q * len(population_profiles)) after exclusions instead of ceil(q * len(eligible_population)).
findings.consequence: The implemented donor domain differs from the frozen mechanism and can change both selection probability and claimed graph effect.
findings.test_gap: The existing reciprocal-pair fixture does not create a case where exclusions change ceil(qN).
findings.required_resolution: Use the eligible-domain cardinality and test quantile boundaries after every distinctness exclusion.

findings.title: The parent-generation trace cannot represent an unsuccessful trial with zero improvement
findings.frozen_requirement: Every parent receives a pre-evaluated trial; only successful F/CR values are added to success memories with strictly positive improvement weights.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/shade_kernel.py:142-148 requires every trial, before comparison, to carry improvement>0.
findings.deterministic_reproduction: A finite worse trial with improvement=0 raises ValueError: trial improvement must be finite and strictly positive.
findings.consequence: A complete generation containing rejected trials cannot be represented honestly without assigning fabricated positive gains, blocking faithful optimizer integration.
findings.test_gap: The one generation fixture gives positive improvement to both trials and contains no rejected zero-gain trial.
findings.required_resolution: Permit finite zero/non-positive placeholder gain for rejected trials, require positive gain only after successful comparison, and test mixed success/failure generations.

findings.title: Evaluator attempts that fail before return are not counted as FFE
findings.frozen_requirement: One call returning objective and complete residual vector consumes one FFE; batch execution must preserve failures and use identical exact budgets.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/accounting.py:61 invokes evaluator, while line 63 increments the ledger only after callback return and output conversion.
findings.deterministic_reproduction: Static control-flow proof: any callback exception before line 63 leaves ledger.ffe unchanged despite an attempted evaluation.
findings.consequence: Failed evaluations can create algorithm-dependent hidden budget advantages and break fair stopping and failure-package accounting.
findings.test_gap: The cache test covers one successful miss and one cache hit only; no failed-call or malformed-output accounting case exists.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze whether every attempted oracle call counts at call entry; recommended policy increments an attempt ledger before invocation and separately records success/failure.

findings.title: A target violating only inactive constraints is diagnosed as FEASIBLE_TARGET
findings.frozen_requirement: Feasibility is determined from the complete violation vector; graph inactivity and target feasibility are distinct diagnostics.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/cvgr_donor.py:205-209 tests only the active-community profile and emits FEASIBLE_TARGET when it is all zero.
findings.consequence: Donor behavior falls back, but feasibility/fallback rates and mechanism diagnostics become scientifically false.
findings.test_gap: The feasible-target test uses a globally zero profile and does not cover inactive-only violations.
findings.required_resolution: Carry complete target feasibility separately and introduce a non-feasible fallback such as NO_ACTIVE_TARGET_VIOLATION.

findings.title: Stable-ID tie-breaking is lexicographic on repr rather than lower numeric ID
findings.frozen_requirement: Exact ties use the lower stable individual ID.

deterministic_reproduction.comparison: stable_id 2 versus stable_id 10 with identical feasible objective

findings.consequence: Tie order changes with identifier representation and can break cross-adapter reproducibility.
findings.test_gap: The existing numeric tie fixture uses 7 and 9, for which numeric and repr ordering coincide.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze a single stable-ID type and canonical total ordering; reject mixed or ambiguous ID domains.

findings.title: Degree-preserving rewiring can silently return an unchanged identity control
findings.frozen_requirement: The negative control must test learned topology against a degree-preserving rewired topology.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/cvgr_donor.py:114-138 returns only the edge set and does not expose requested versus successful swaps.
findings.consequence: The control can equal the learned graph while still being labeled rewired, making a graph-specific comparison uninterpretable.
findings.test_gap: Existing tests verify degree preservation and simplicity but not non-identity or achieved-swap telemetry.
findings.required_resolution: Return attempts/successful swaps and graph identity; predefine resampling, inapplicability or INCONCLUSIVE handling when a non-identity rewire cannot be formed.

findings.title: Cache output validation and immutability are not closed
findings.frozen_requirement: NaN/Inf must fail closed, cached records must preserve raw evidence, and cache hits must not mutate history or FFE.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/accounting.py:61-65 converts and stores outputs without finite/shape validation and returns the same mutable residual array on later hits.
findings.deterministic_reproduction: Static data-flow proof: the cached Evaluation tuple contains a mutable ndarray that is returned directly at line 59.
findings.consequence: A caller can mutate historical residual evidence; malformed/nonfinite results can enter the cache before graph-side fail-closed checks.
findings.test_gap: No mutation-isolation, finite-output, fixed constraint-count or malformed-output test exists.
findings.required_resolution: Validate objective/residual finiteness and ordered length, store immutable copies, and return copies or read-only views with provenance.

findings.title: Future run-path components are not sanitized
findings.frozen_requirement: The experiment system must use collision-checked stable run IDs and paths while preserving packages.
findings.implementation_evidence: src/alg1_replan/experiment_contracts.py:172-184 rejects pipes but not slash, backslash, dot-dot or reserved path components; line 214 embeds the resulting key in a planned path.
findings.deterministic_reproduction: Static path proof: matrix/algorithm/problem IDs containing path separators can become path segments outside the intended logical attempt directory in a future writer.
findings.consequence: The present in-memory dry run is safe, but promoting it to file-writing S6-E0 infrastructure without an identity grammar can misplace or collide run packages.
findings.test_gap: No traversal, separator, Windows reserved-name or Unicode-normalization fixture exists.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze a portable identifier grammar and construct filesystem paths from a digest plus separately stored display IDs.

coverage_summary.reason_green_suite_missed_findings: The frozen suite checks representative gold paths and declared fallback reasons but lacks adversarial measurement-universe, subthreshold-weight, post-exclusion quantile, rejected-trial, failed-call and control-identity boundaries.

verdict.rationale: The accepted package is byte-stable and its 46 declared tests remain collectible, but five critical spec/code or measurement gaps can change activation, donor domains, generation semantics, FFE fairness or the primary mechanism endpoint.

governance_effect.next_gate: Author decision on preparation of a versioned mechanism-integrity specification amendment and additive expected-red tests only.
